slides.headline: Volume shares better than judgement.
slides.body: A list titled fifty prompts performs well because fifty is bigger than twelve. Every one generates unvetted output.

slides.headline: When people fall asleep at the wheel.
slides.body: A BCG field experiment showed AI users worked twenty-five percent faster, but accuracy dropped on complex tasks.

items.label: Routine tasks
items.detail: Speed and quality both increase significantly

visual.note: Harvard, Wharton and BCG field experiment

slides.headline: Force the model to disagree with you.
slides.body: A prompt worth keeping attacks your brief, stresses your positioning, or red-teams your plan before it writes.

items.label: Stress-test
items.detail: Attack positioning as a skeptical buyer

items.label: Red-team
items.detail: Argue the strongest case against the plan

slides.headline: Test every prompt against one question.
slides.body: If the model agreed with you by default, you learned nothing. Rewrite it to force a weak point or missing proof.

items.label: Default agreement
items.detail: Discard prompts that merely validate your view

items.label: Forced friction
items.detail: Keep prompts that surface hidden objections

slides.headline: Run this test on your next brief.
slides.body: Ask AI to list every assumption the brief makes without stating it, and three questions to ask before starting work.

items.label: Block solutions
items.detail: Forbid ideas until questions are answered

slides.headline: Judgement is the bottleneck.
slides.body: AI governance for marketing teams starts when you stop optimising for speed and start optimising for friction. Read the full twelve-prompt list on my site.

caption:
Prompts make you faster at being wrong.

AI governance for marketing teams fails when we treat language models as copywriters instead of sparring partners. If a prompt's output agrees with you by default, it is decorating a decision you had already made.

The twelve prompts I actually reuse are built to argue, interrogate briefs, and red-team plans before a single draft gets written. The full list and source prompts are on my site: https://www.rachitmishra.in/2026/09/28/ai-prompts-for-marketers/

Send this to whoever is defending their AI tool budget this quarter.
